newsitem.title: USA: U.S. SPOT PRODUCTS--U.S. GASOLINE DIFFS WEAKEN.
newsitem.headline: U.S. SPOT PRODUCTS--U.S. GASOLINE DIFFS WEAKEN.

text.p: U.S. gasoline differentials weakened in slow Monday morning activity, with sellers in New York Harbor aggressively looking for buyers.
Monday's declines, however, may see greater aggravation later in the day following news Tosco is restarting the crude unit at its 250,000 barrel per day Bayway refinery in New Jersey.
The plant's cat cracker is also on target for restart Aug 16-17.
On NYMEX, September gasoline was down 0.24 cent at 61.75 cents a gallon. Heating oil was up 0.21 cent at 54.50 cents and crude oil was up 0.10 cents at $19.64 a barrel.
Unleaded and reformulated gasoline differentials weakened in New York Harbor in quiet trade on Monday, as sellers fought for few buyers.

"Differentials are weaker because people are realizing there" are imports from Europe and the Caribbean coming in," said a Harbor trader, adding differentials are likely to see further declines this week.
On Monday, prompt barrels of M2 conventional unleaded northern-grade gasoline dropped a half cent to put offers at 4.50 cents over the screen. Any months were steady at 1.25 cents.
A2 reformulated northern-grade was down about a penny at 5.50/6.00 cents over the screen, with the any months at about 2.50 cents.
Prompt gasoline differentials showed modest weakness early Monday, though traders said activity was slow to begin.
"People are putting out some feelers, but there not a lot of action yet," one Gulf trader said.
Prompt conventional regular M1 gasoline differentials were offered at about 0.50 cent under the September futures, a dip of about 0.40 cent from Friday's levels.
Reformulated A1 gasoline appeared to hover inside its recent range, about 3.00 to 3.50 cents over the M1 gasoline, traders said.

Distillate differentials were seen unchanged Monday, with few players showing interest. Prompt heating oil was quoted at 2.75 cents under the September NYMEX, while prompt low sulphur diesel was seen between 2.00 and 2.25 cents under the screen.

Midcontinent unleaded gasoline differentials eased in light activity on Monday. Group Three unleaded gasoline was down a cent at 3.75/4.00 cent a gallon. Chicago gasoline fell a half cent to 3.00/3.25 cents.
Group Three low sulphur diesel was steady at 1.00 cent over the print, but Chicago was down about a half cent at 1.25/1.50 cent below the screen.
